sr.h_podnaslov: Brza i pouzdana usluga za vaše gume
sr.d_t1: Više od 15 godina brinemo o gumama vozača iz Zrenjanina i okoline. Radimo brzo, precizno i po fer cenama.
sr.d_t2: Bilo da vam treba zamena guma, balansiranje, krpljenje ili nove gume, naš tim završava posao dok čekate.
sr.p_podnaslov: Sve što vašim gumama treba na jednom mestu
sr.k_zamena_o: Montaža i demontaža guma na svim dimenzijama felni.
sr.k_balans_o: Kompjutersko balansiranje za miran i tih hod.
sr.k_krp_o: Stručna popravka proboja i manjih oštećenja.
sr.k_prodaja_o: Nove i polovne gume poznatih proizvođača.
sr.b_tekst: Preskočite gužvu. Javite nam se i rezervisaćemo vreme za vas.
sr.f_opis: Pouzdana vulkanizerska usluga u Zrenjaninu. Zamena, balansiranje, krpljenje i prodaja guma.
sr.on_t1: Vulkanizer Točak počeo je 2010. godine kao mala radionica u Zrenjaninu. Danas smo jedna od poznatijih vulkanizerskih radnji u gradu.
sr.on_t2: Naši majstori rade sa modernom opremom i o svakom točku brinu kao da je njihov.
sr.on_t3: Mušterije nam se vraćaju zbog iskrenog saveta, fer cena i brze usluge.
sr.on_vred_o: Principi kojima se vodimo svakog dana
sr.vr1_o: Većina poslova završi se za manje od 30 minuta.
sr.vr2_o: Moderne mašine i pažljivo birani materijali.
sr.vr3_o: Popravljamo ili menjamo samo ono što je zaista potrebno.
sr.vr4_o: Vaša sigurnost na putu nam je na prvom mestu.
sr.u_podnaslov: Stručna nega guma za svako vozilo
sr.u_zamena_o: Montaža i demontaža guma za putnička vozila, kombije i SUV.
sr.u_balans_o: Precizno kompjutersko balansiranje uklanja vibracije u vožnji.
sr.u_krp_o: Popravka proboja i manjih oštećenja metodom vulkanizacije.
sr.u_prodaja_o: Veliki izbor novih i polovnih letnjih, zimskih i svesezonskih guma.
sr.u_skl_o: Sigurno čuvamo vaše sezonske gume, suvo i označeno.
sr.u_azot_o: Azot duže održava stabilan pritisak u gumama.
sr.fq1: Da li je potrebno zakazivanje termina?
sr.fa1: Nije obavezno, ali zakazivanjem izbegavate čekanje.
sr.fa2: Zamena četiri gume obično traje oko 30 minuta.
sr.fa3: Preporučujemo pri svakoj zameni guma ili kada primetite vibracije.
sr.k_podnaslov: Pozovite nas, posetite nas ili pošaljite poruku
sr.g_datum: Izaberite datum koji nije u prošlosti.
sr.l_saglasnost: Saglasan/na sam sa obradom ličnih podataka.
sr.k_uspeh: Hvala! Vaša poruka je poslata. Javićemo vam se u najkraćem roku.
sr.ph_poruka: Dimenzija gume, tip vozila, željeno vreme...

en.f_opis: Reliable tire service in Zrenjanin. Tire replacement, balancing, repair and sales.
en.h_podnaslov: Fast and reliable service for your tires
en.d_t1: For more than 15 years we have been taking care of the tires of drivers in Zrenjanin and the surrounding area. We work quickly, precisely and at fair prices.
en.d_t2: Whether you need a tire change, balancing, a puncture repair or new tires, our team will finish the job while you wait.
en.p_podnaslov: Everything your tires need in one place
en.k_zamena_o: Fitting and removing tires on all rim sizes.
en.k_balans_o: Computer balancing for a smooth and quiet ride.
en.k_krp_o: Professional repair of punctures and small damage.
en.k_prodaja_o: New and used tires from well-known brands.
en.v_naslov: Take a look at our workshop
en.b_tekst: Skip the queue. Contact us and we will reserve a time for you.
en.on_podnaslov: Meet the team behind Točak Tire Shop
en.on_t1: Točak Tire Shop started in 2010 as a small workshop in Zrenjanin. Today we are one of the best known tire shops in the city.
en.on_t2: Our mechanics work with modern equipment and take care of every wheel as if it were their own.
en.on_t3: Customers return to us because of honest advice, fair prices and quick service.
en.on_vred_o: Principles we work by every day
en.vr1_o: Most jobs are finished in under 30 minutes.
en.vr2_o: Modern machines and carefully selected materials.
en.vr3_o: We only repair or replace what is really needed.
en.vr4_o: Your safety on the road is our first priority.
en.u_podnaslov: Professional tire care for every vehicle
en.u_zamena_o: Fitting and removing tires for passenger cars, vans and SUVs.
en.u_balans_o: Precise computer balancing removes vibrations while driving.
en.u_krp_o: Repair of punctures and small damage using the vulcanization method.
en.u_prodaja_o: Wide choice of new and used summer, winter and all-season tires.
en.u_skl_o: We store your seasonal tires safely, dry and labeled.
en.u_azot_o: Nitrogen keeps tire pressure stable for longer.
en.r2: Replacement of 4 tires (17 inch and larger)
en.fq1: Do I need to book an appointment?
en.fa1: It is not required, but booking a time lets you skip the waiting.
en.fq2: How long does a tire change take?
en.fa2: Changing four tires usually takes about 30 minutes.
en.fq3: How often should wheels be balanced?
en.fa3: We recommend balancing every time you change tires or when you notice vibrations.
en.k_podnaslov: Call us, visit us or send a message

en.ph_poruka: Tire size, vehicle type, preferred time...
en.g_ime: Enter your full name (at least 3 characters).
en.g_datum: Select a date that is not in the past.
en.k_uspeh: Thank you! Your message has been sent. We will contact you shortly.
